customer_name: China Iron and Steel Research Institute Group (中国钢研科技集团)
business_problem: China Iron and Steel Research needed a practical way to apply large-model and visual AI capabilities across metallurgical research and manufacturing, especially for metallography analysis, surface defect detection, and long-process material tracking that older methods struggled to deliver cost-effectively.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud and China Iron and Steel Research built a metallurgy-focused large-model platform around an IPS three-layer architecture and a private deployment product stack. The design combines Qianfan, Baige, Yijian, Zhenzhi, Kunlun, and related private-cloud capabilities so model building and application delivery can move together from platform to business scenario. Instead of treating the large model as a generic assistant, the joint team centered the implementation on a 'process-aware' metallurgy model that could validate real industry workflows. In practice, this meant using platform capabilities to stand up and verify models for metallography analysis, hot-rolled surface defect detection, and large-scene cross-domain material tracking. The stack also optimized Kunlun and the major Baidu platforms for fast delivery after contract signing. By tying model training, visual analysis, report generation, and process tracking to concrete metallurgy scenarios, the project moved from abstract AI experimentation into an operational industrial analytics system.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the large-model platform capabilities used to build and validate metallurgy-specific AI workflows.

solution_components.name: Baige AI Heterogeneous Computing Platform
solution_components.role: Supplies the compute backbone for training and validating metallurgy models across image-heavy industrial scenarios.

solution_components.name: Kunlun
solution_components.role: Supports the optimized delivery stack that helped the metallurgy platform reach production quickly after the project was signed.

data_flow: Metallography images, steel-surface defect images, and material-tracking scene data feed into the private deployment stack, Qianfan and Baige support model training and validation, and the finished workflows generate reports, defect analysis, and cross-domain tracking outputs for metallurgy operations.
business_outcome: China Iron and Steel Research established a metallurgy large-model platform that delivered measurable breakthroughs on core industrial scenarios while demonstrating a workable domestic AI stack for central-enterprise manufacturing innovation.
architecture_clues: The program uses an IPS three-layer architecture and a private deployment product system rather than a public-only stack.
The platform was optimized around concrete metallurgy workflows instead of generic prompt-only use cases.
The stack had to support both visual inspection tasks and large-scene cross-domain tracking with report generation.
evidence_quotes: China Iron and Steel Research wanted to build a metallurgy-industry large-model platform and empower the industry with a 'process-aware large model'. (original: 中国钢研与百度等企业深化合作，建设基于人工智能技术的冶金行业大模型平台，面向行业提供“流程感知大模型”，赋能冶金行业。)

The implementation realized the full landing of a private deployment product system under an IPS three-layer architecture and fused Qianfan, Baige, Yijian, Zhenzhi, and related platform capabilities into applications. (original: 通过IPS三层架构的整体规划，实现了万源私有化产品体系的全面落地。从业务场景出发，依据千帆、百舸、一见、甄知等平台的核心能力，实现从产品到应用的深度融合。)

In metallography analysis, the model reached MIOU of at least 90% and PA of at least 96%, with one ferrite-plus-austenite model recording MIOU 91.44% and accuracy 97.30%. (original: 大模型性能指标MIOU(平均交并比)≥90%，PA(像素准确率)≥96%。完成铁素体+少量奥氏体数据的模型训练，模型性能指标： MIOU：91.44%；准确率:97.30%。)

In surface defect detection, the model achieved precision of at least 95%, recall of at least 94%, and a processing speed of 2000 images in 100 seconds. (original: 模型精确率≥95%，召回率≥94%；处理速度达到100秒2000张图片。)
For material tracking, the system reached 100 ms response time, MOTA of at least 95%, and MOTP of at least 90%. (original: 模型响应速度100ms，MOTA(跟踪准确度)≥95%，MOTP(跟踪精度)≥90%。)
